frozen_definition: SIZE_RAW=-log(positive canonical issuer-level market cap in CRSP USD thousands)
economic_rationale: Higher score represents a smaller issuer
pit_rule: explicit canonical availability on or before signal date
notes: No security DlyCap substitution or partial issuer aggregation

frozen_definition: Latest PIT-valid quarterly-derived TTM is primary and latest PIT-valid annual is whole-metric fallback
economic_rationale: Uses timely information without coverage or performance choice
pit_rule: source availability date must be on or before signal date
fallback_rule: annual only when full quarterly logical metric unavailable
notes: Never mix annual and quarterly components

frozen_definition: Latest PIT-valid quarterly stock is primary and latest PIT-valid annual stock is whole-metric fallback
economic_rationale: Uses the latest reported balance-sheet state without future information
pit_rule: source availability date must be on or before signal date
fallback_rule: annual only when quarterly stock unavailable

frozen_definition: TTM NIQ from four consecutive PIT-valid quarters times 1000 divided by issuer market cap; annual NI is fallback
data_source: Compustat NIQ or NI plus canonical issuer market cap
pit_rule: all quarterly observations and denominator must be available by signal date
fallback_rule: latest valid annual NI divided by CEQ-consistent issuer denominator
neutralization_rule: Value later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector
notes: Financial and Real Estate branches retain E/P

frozen_definition: Latest PIT-valid CEQQ times 1000 divided by issuer market cap; annual CEQ is fallback
economic_rationale: Retains economically meaningful negative common equity
data_source: Compustat CEQQ or CEQ plus canonical issuer market cap
pit_rule: stock numerator must be available by signal date
neutralization_rule: Value later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector
notes: Do not replace CEQ with alternate book-equity formula

frozen_definition: TTM OANCFY minus TTM CAPXY from four valid canonical single quarters times 1000 divided by issuer market cap; annual OANCF minus CAPX is fallback
economic_rationale: Retains negative FCF and preserves coherent flow frequency
data_source: Compustat OANCFY CAPXY or OANCF CAPX plus issuer market cap
pit_rule: all same-frequency flow inputs available by signal date
fallback_rule: latest valid annual OANCF minus CAPX
neutralization_rule: Value later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector

frozen_definition: TTM NIQ divided by latest CEQQ at TTM endpoint; annual NI divided by same-observation CEQ is fallback
economic_rationale: Pairs profit flow with contemporaneous equity without future averaging
data_source: Compustat NIQ CEQQ or NI CEQ
pit_rule: all paired values available by signal date
neutralization_rule: Quality later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector
notes: Zero denominator unavailable and negative equity retained

frozen_definition: TTM NIQ divided by latest ATQ; annual NI divided by same-observation AT is fallback
economic_rationale: Pairs profit flow with contemporaneous assets
data_source: Compustat NIQ ATQ or NI AT
pit_rule: all paired values available by signal date
neutralization_rule: Quality later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector
notes: Used only by GICS 40 and 60 branch

frozen_definition: TTM approved Sales or Revenue minus approved COGS divided by latest ATQ; annual equivalent is fallback
economic_rationale: Uses frozen gross-profit economics without zero-filling COGS
data_source: approved canonical Compustat Sales Revenue COGS and assets
pit_rule: all paired values available by signal date
neutralization_rule: Quality later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector

frozen_definition: Negative of (DLCQ plus DLTTQ) divided by ATQ; annual negative of (DLC plus DLTT) divided by AT is fallback
economic_rationale: Higher score represents lower debt relative to assets
data_source: approved canonical Compustat debt and asset fields
pit_rule: all required paired values available by signal date
neutralization_rule: Quality later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector
notes: Missing debt components are not zero-filled

frozen_definition: Negative of latest PIT-valid ATQ divided by exact same fiscal quarter prior-year ATQ minus one; annual same-issuer prior-year AT fallback
economic_rationale: Higher score represents lower asset growth
pit_rule: each current and lag observation must be PIT-valid by signal date
neutralization_rule: Investment later neutralized by issuer log market cap and historical GICS Sector

frozen_definition: All historical GICS Sector dummies valid on signal date and no separate intercept
economic_rationale: Controls documented sector composition without current-GICS backfill
pit_rule: sector assignment must be valid on signal date
neutralization_rule: all dummies retained and none dropped
notes: Industry Group Industry and Sub-Industry are not baseline controls

frozen_definition: log of positive canonical issuer-level market capitalization
economic_rationale: Controls issuer scale with the same economic level as formal Value denominator
pit_rule: market cap must be explicitly available on signal date
neutralization_rule: regression control with all historical GICS Sector dummies and no intercept

frozen_definition: Ordinary CRSP cash-dividend events accepted by Phase 2B using audited ex-date and trailing interval (signal_date-365 days signal_date]
economic_rationale: Uses security-level cash distributions without changing return accounting
data_source: CRSP Distribution CIZ formal raw file
pit_rule: event ex-date must be on or before signal date

frozen_definition: Adjust historical cash dividends to signal-date share basis only with exact audited CRSP split semantics
economic_rationale: Ensures numerator and signal-date price share bases are comparable
data_source: CRSP Distribution CIZ split fields and Phase 2B evidence
pit_rule: only events available by ex-date participate
fallback_rule: block Dividend if deterministic adjustment is unsupported

frozen_definition: Split-normalized trailing ordinary cash dividend per share divided by positive finite canonical signal-date security price
economic_rationale: Maintains a security-level per-share economic ratio
data_source: CRSP Distribution extension plus canonical security price
pit_rule: complete trailing window and price must be valid
fallback_rule: zero only for complete window with no eligible ordinary event
notes: Issuer market cap is not the dividend denominator
